claim: Practical Magic 2 opened at No. 1 in North America with an estimated $30M, a mainstream catalyst for the witchy-kitchen aesthetic.
excerpt: Search summary: estimated $30 million from 4,146 theaters; ended Spider-Man: Brand New Day's six-weekend run at No. 1; about $16M from 77 international markets, roughly $46M worldwide.
title: 'Practical Magic 2' conjures a No. 1 box office debut
